title: The Irish Rovers - All Hung Up Album Cover
coreRelationships: The marionette figures are the central focus, arranged in a horizontal line across the lower half of the composition.
The strings extending from the figures' heads and limbs create a strong vertical visual element, leading the eye upwards to the album title.
The vibrant green of the figures' sweaters and the colorful lettering of the band name provide strong contrast against the muted background.
The instruments held by the figures are detailed and contribute to the narrative of a musical performance.
The tracklist text is positioned as a secondary informational element, clearly separated from the main title and imagery.
